entries.name: UPS_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The Client ID of a UPS developer app with the Tracking product. It is sent to UPS only, with the secret, to sign in.
howToGet: Sign in at developer.ups.com with the business's UPS account and open Apps.
Add an app for KaratOS, link the shipper account, add only the Tracking product, and copy its Client ID.

entries.name: UPS_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The app's Client Secret. With only the Tracking product added, it can read tracking and nothing else: no labels, pickups or billing.
howToGet: On the same app's page at developer.ups.com, copy the Client Secret.
Put it straight into the instance's Railway variables. Never send it by chat or email.

entries.name: UPS_TRACKING_NUMBERS_FILE
entries.description: A text or CSV file of the UPS tracking numbers to follow, one or more a line, such as the labels printed for repairs, memo goods and customer orders. Lines starting with # are skipped. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Export the tracking numbers from UPS's shipping history, the POS or the shipping app.
Save it outside any git repo and put its path here. Add new numbers as parcels go out; delivered ones are no longer read.

entries.name: UPS_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: production (the default) reads live tracking; test uses UPS's Customer Integration Environment, which only answers UPS's test numbers.

entries.name: UPS_MAX_TRACKING_PER_SYNC
entries.description: The most tracking numbers one sync reads, oldest first. Defaults to 500, so a long list can't use up the app's daily call limit in one sync.
